note: STD-660, STD-661. The operation_bodies rows carry FSL FR-576's per-operation body: a reference to the checked body function node or the typed absence no_body, keyed by selected document, declaring node and original operation name (the key of operation_effects). Each case's documents are compact excerpts of the selected FR-154 model documents (types with their declared operations and an optional extends listing the identities of the declared supertypes; an operation carries an optional redefines naming the identity of the supertype operation it redefines, Operation.redefines of FR-154, and an operation of the same name without it redefines nothing); a document carries no has_body, so whether an operation has a body is derived from graph_nodes alone: a function node whose owner is the operation member and whose clause is body. graph_nodes lists the package graph nodes the body references resolve against, each with its form and, for a function node, its FR-094 owner and clause; every owner-bearing node already joined its owner. The optional dispatch_candidates are excerpts of checked_term_data dispatch candidates with their selected_operation, selection_key and operation_body; a candidate joins the row of the type that declares the effective operation of its selection_key receiver, when the receiver is in the family of the candidate's selected_operation (FR-322 "Candidate join"). dispatch_join_refusals are cases the carrier admits because their candidate is outside the family; the recorded code and locus are the dispatch join's (FR-322-AC-290) in checked_term_data, not the carrier's. schema_refusals and reader_refusals are RFC 6902 patches over the rows of their base positive case, applied to {"operation_bodies": rows}; a reader case may replace the base dispatch_candidates. Loci are absolute JSON pointers into that package member.

positive.description: one operation with an authored body: the row references its checked body function node
one operation without an authored body: the row carries the typed absence no_body and no node
two members of one object, one with a body and one without; rows sorted by key
settle under a process of one document and two object types of another: separate rows, distinct bodies or no_body; subtype Premium inherits settle and has no row
Order.settle is a dispatch candidate whose operation_body equals the row body
a selected document declares no operation: the member is present and empty, which is not absent

Service.run is redefined by FastService.run and SafeService.run (each with Operation.redefines naming it) and inherited by Plain; the dispatch table has three candidates of one selected_operation, each in the family of Service.run and joined through its selection_key to the row of the type that declares its receiver's effective run. Stray conforms to no type

schema_refusals.description: row without its body, so absence is never implied by omission
row with a member the closed schema does not name
operation that is not an identifier
body null instead of a reference or no_body
body as a bare node reference without its kind
function body with an extra member
function body whose node reference lacks its ordinal

reader_refusals.description: row document that is no selection of the lock
declaring node of a package that is not selected
declaring node the selected package does not declare
declaring node that is a relationship
declaring node owned by a document other than the row document
operation that names a field
row for subtype Premium naming the operation it only inherits from Order
no_body for an operation the document gives a body
a function body for an operation the document gives none
body node the package graph does not hold
body node that is an expression and not a function
row body that differs from the operation_body of a dispatch candidate for the same operation
a repeated key
rows out of key order
an operation without a row
an empty member while operations exist
a body node that belongs to another operation of the same document: the bodies of Order.settle and Order.touch swapped
a precondition clause function of the row's own operation in place of its body
a body node of another document's package

no_body row for Invoice.settle while the dispatch candidate of the Invoice family (selected_operation Invoice.settle, receiver Invoice) carries a body node that exists in the graph; the candidate is in its family and joins the Invoice row
the SafeService candidate carries the body of the FastService candidate, which the SafeService row does not name

dispatch_join_refusals.description: a dispatch candidate whose receiver Stray does not conform to Service, the declaring type of selected_operation Service.run: the carrier leaves it to the dispatch join and admits the rows; the dispatch join refuses the candidate's selection key
